description: Bartholomew Sovereign MCP Tool Registry — 25 native tools for AI coding security, compliance, and autonomous agent protection.

tools.name: btp_protect
tools.description: Evaluate a shell command or file operation against all AST invariants. Returns verdict, rule_id, latency, and Merkle receipt.

tools.name: btp_check
tools.description: Lightweight sub-5us in-process check for dangerous command patterns.

tools.name: btp_audit
tools.description: Return the last 25 intercepted actions from the audit ledger with full Merkle receipts.

tools.name: btp_status
tools.description: Return current workspace security score, grade, active invariants, and passkey state.

tools.name: btp_inject_ai_rules
tools.description: Write GEMINI.md, CLAUDE.md, and .cursorrules with live invariant briefing for the active AI model.

tools.name: btp_model_context
tools.description: Generate cryptographically grounded invariant briefing for any AI companion model (Gemini, Claude, Cursor, Copilot).

tools.name: btp_keystone_issue
tools.description: Issue a scoped Keystone Capability Passkey for an autonomous agent with file, command, network, and spend limits.

tools.name: btp_keystone_verify
tools.description: Verify an active Keystone Passkey is valid and has not expired or been tampered with.

tools.name: btp_keystone_revoke
tools.description: Revoke the current workspace Keystone Passkey immediately.

tools.name: btp_keystone_evaluate
tools.description: Evaluate a proposed agent action (file write, command exec) against the active Keystone clearance scopes.

tools.name: btp_heal
tools.description: Auto-heal a proposed dangerous command into a safe equivalent and return the repaired version.

tools.name: btp_jit_self_repair
tools.description: Analyze a Python traceback and synthesize a deterministic AST-level repair patch.

tools.name: btp_compress
tools.description: Compress the workspace codebase context by 69.6% using AST structural skeletons for cheaper LLM prompts.

tools.name: btp_optimize
tools.description: Generate workflow shortcuts, import cycles fixes, and parallel test optimization for the active repository.

tools.name: btp_profile
tools.description: Profile active AI agent calls for latency bottlenecks and suggest caching and batching improvements.

tools.name: btp_collaborate
tools.description: Detect all active IDE extensions and generate a collaboration mesh config (.btp/collaborate.json).

tools.name: btp_ecosystem_advisor
tools.description: Analyze installed extensions and suggest improvements, workflows, shortcuts, and alternative approaches.

tools.name: btp_stream_siem_telemetry
tools.description: Stream audit events to Splunk, Datadog, CrowdStrike, or AWS Security Hub in real time.

tools.name: btp_ring0_kernel_guard
tools.description: Verify kernel-level syscall constraints and eBPF hook integrity for untrusted agent isolation.

tools.name: btp_swarm_ops
tools.description: Display real-time swarm operations center snapshot with evaluation counts and neutralized threat stats.

tools.name: btp_zk_mesh_attestation
tools.description: Generate and aggregate zero-knowledge proof commitments across a multi-agent fleet without revealing source code.

tools.name: btp_compliance_report
tools.description: Generate a SOC 2 / ISO 27001 evidence pack with Merkle proof chain and audit ledger export.

tools.name: btp_policy_validate
tools.description: Lint and validate a workspace .btp/policy.yaml against the BTP invariant schema.

tools.name: btp_dry_run_trace
tools.description: Run a synthetic agent trace through the policy engine and return a full pass/block simulation.

tools.name: btp_flight_deck
tools.description: Start the Bartholomew Sovereign Flight Deck dashboard on localhost:8787 with live invariant telemetry.
